description: Search products, browse categories, get product details with all seller offers, or scrape reviews from Yandex Market.

categoryUrls.description: Yandex Market category page URLs (mode=browseCategory). Use the /list form, e.g. https://market.yandex.ru/catalog--smartfony/54726/list.
categoryUrls.title: Category URLs

maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to return per query/URL. Also caps offers per product and reviews per URL.
maxItems.title: Max Items

maxPrice.description: Maximum price filter in Russian rubles. Only applies in searchProducts and browseCategory modes.
maxPrice.title: Max Price (RUB)

minPrice.description: Minimum price filter in Russian rubles. Only applies in searchProducts and browseCategory modes.
minPrice.title: Min Price (RUB)

minRating.description: Filter out products below this rating. Only applies in searchProducts and browseCategory modes.
minRating.title: Min Rating (search & category only)

mode.description: What to scrape. searchProducts: find products by keyword. browseCategory: scrape a product category. getProductDetails: full details + all seller offers for specific product URLs. getReviews: scrape product or seller reviews.
enumTitles: Get product details + all seller offers
mode.title: Mode

productUrls.description: Yandex Market product page URLs (mode=getProductDetails or getReviews). Format: https://market.yandex.ru/product--{slug}/{id}
productUrls.title: Product URLs

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. No proxy is required: listing modes use cookieless HTTP first. If Yandex Market proves a request is blocked, the actor automatically tries its residential proxy and then a browser fallback. Provide this only to override that automatic fallback.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration (optional)

reviewsSortOrder.description: How to sort reviews. Only applies in getReviews mode.
reviewsSortOrder.title: Reviews Sort Order (getReviews only)

searchQueries.description: One or more search queries (mode=searchProducts). Examples: 'iPhone 15', 'Samsung Galaxy S24', or Russian keywords.
searchQueries.title: Search Queries

sellerUrls.description: Yandex Market seller page URLs (mode=getReviews only). Format: https://market.yandex.ru/shop--{slug}/{id}
sellerUrls.title: Seller URLs (getReviews only)

sortOrder.description: How to sort search results. Only applies in searchProducts and browseCategory modes.
sortOrder.title: Sort Order (search & category only)

title: Yandex Market Scraper Input
